scenarios.name: Create patient while offline
scenarios.description: Durable Dexie write with local_version=1 and QUEUED outbox entry

scenarios.name: Edit patient while offline
scenarios.description: Atomic update increments local_version=2 and queues UPDATE outbox operation

scenarios.name: Delete patient while offline
scenarios.description: Soft-delete sets is_deleted=true, records tombstone, and queues DELETE operation

scenarios.name: Restart / reload while offline
scenarios.description: IndexedDB stores outbox queue across browser restart and device reboot

scenarios.name: Kill process during transaction
scenarios.description: IndexedDB single transaction boundary guarantees domain entity + outbox are committed atomically

scenarios.name: Network disappears during sync
scenarios.description: Outbox status remains QUEUED or transitions safely to FAILED with automatic exponential backoff retry

scenarios.name: Server timeout after successful commit
scenarios.description: Re-transmitting operation UUID returns cached APPLIED or DUPLICATE without side-effects

scenarios.name: Server returns HTTP 500 error
scenarios.description: Transient error handled with backoff retry policy; local records remain intact

scenarios.name: Server returns malformed response
scenarios.description: Client sync engine catches JSON parse exceptions without dropping queued mutations

scenarios.name: Authentication expires while offline
scenarios.description: Expired JWT returns 401 Unauthorized; mutations remain safely queued locally until re-login

scenarios.name: Account disabled before reconnect
scenarios.description: Deactivated user account receives 403 Forbidden; server rejects write while local data is preserved

scenarios.name: Duplicate single operation replay
scenarios.description: Server idempotency log detects duplicate operation UUID and returns DUPLICATE status

scenarios.name: Duplicate entire batch replay
scenarios.description: Full batch re-transmission processed idempotently with duplicate_count matched

scenarios.name: Out-of-order operations
scenarios.description: Client sequence ordering sorts mutations sequentially prior to server push

scenarios.name: Concurrent edits from two devices (A & B)
scenarios.description: Independent demographic field edits merge; conflicting version mismatch returns CONFLICT and stages payload

scenarios.name: Offline deletion + remote update
scenarios.description: Tombstones take precedence over stale edits; entity is not resurrected

scenarios.name: Old workflow version assessment sync
scenarios.description: Historical assessment retains ruleset_version=2.0.0 without silent server recalculation

scenarios.name: Schema migration with queued records
scenarios.description: Dexie v4 version upgrade preserves existing pending outbox records

scenarios.name: Multiple simultaneous sync workers
scenarios.description: SyncManager isSyncing lease lock prevents duplicate concurrent execution

scenarios.name: Browser restart during active sync
scenarios.description: Interrupted sync resumes from last acknowledged client sequence cursor
